title: Harden validation and public-release docs
description: Patch dependency cycle detection, empty-story completion behavior, and align docs/skills for public release.
acceptanceCriteria: Doctor detects broken and transitive circular dependencies.
Implementation run does not report all-complete when prd/ has no stories.
Public docs and skills use Evoloop naming and repo-relative guidance.
Repository does not track local runtime state or personal machine paths.

deploySafety.strategy: Manual release from main with explicit tag push
deploySafety.rollbackTrigger: Any post-release preflight failure or reported workflow regression
deploySafety.rollbackCommand: git revert <release-commit-sha> && git push origin main

planning.notes: Planning baseline approved for maintenance hardening.
